name: 54557 · Presque Isle, WI
findings: ZIP 54557 (Presque Isle) has 11 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (73%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54557 (Presque Isle) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
